environment: Synthetic accounts, isolated H2, real AWS SDK with local S3 test server

checks.name: Create a category with exactly 72-hour expiry and visible deletion notice
Real authenticated multipart upload, R2 PUT/HEAD verification, signed image read, and failed-upload retry without losing draft
Photo and synthetic browser voice recording both reach R2 and are linked to their category
Recipient can browse the shared category but cannot delete or run cleanup
An already-open category list removes expired cards at the deadline
Confirmed deletion immediately hides records; failed storage cleanup stays queued; retry deletes every photo/audio object and DB row
